facts.fact: Canadian Business and PROFIT placed StackAdapt at No. 39 on the 2017 STARTUP 50 ranking of Canada's Top New Growth Companies.
facts.quote: Today, Canadian Business and PROFIT unveiled StackAdapt as No. 39 on the 2017 STARTUP 50 ranking of Canada’s Top New Growth Companies.

facts.fact: The STARTUP 50 ranking orders younger companies by two-year revenue growth.
facts.quote: the STARTUP 50 ranks younger companies on two-year revenue growth.

facts.fact: STARTUP 50 winners are profiled in the October issue of Maclean's magazine and online at CanadianBusiness.com.
